title: AI provider layer hardening before the categorizer: chat timeout vs 16k max_tokens, providerFor(resolved) helper, OpenAI model filter, restricted-key 403, log redaction
description: From the second review of budget-q8kf (attached). 1) Anthropic default max_tokens 16000 runs non-streaming under the 60s chat timeout in api/src/ai/http.ts: long thinking turns time out, are retried and billed; raise the chat timeout or stream. 2) The provider-match rule lives only in routes; export one helper (providerFor(resolved)) from api/src/ai/index.ts so callers cannot send a resolved key to another provider, and stop exporting the raw pair. 3) OpenAI chat-model filter drops ft:gpt-* and search-preview models and keeps non-chat-completions models (gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, o1/o3/gpt-5-pro: verify against OpenAI docs). 4) OpenAI restricted key without models:read gets 403 on /models and is reported as a bad key; verify with a call such keys can make. 5) Log redaction only masks the exact key and sk-*; mask other provider key shapes and do not log upstream account/quota text at a level any user can trigger. 6) Save with a model and every test call /models twice. 7) A row whose secret no longer opens reports effective 'own' while resolveAiKey says unreadable. 8) Z.ai: confirm /api/paas/v4/models with a real key or fall back to a chat ping.
notes:
All eight review items addressed in 378984ac, each with a test that fails without the fix. Docs verified first: Anthropic Claude 5+ has thinking on by default (16k cap stands); OpenAI gpt-5-pro/o1-pro/o3-pro are Responses-only while ft: and *-search-preview are Chat Completions; OpenAI /models needs the separate api.model.read scope (403 on a chat-only restricted key); Z.ai's docs/OpenAPI list no /models endpoint. Fixes: (1) chat deadline = max(60s, cap/25 tok/s) and a timeout is kind permanent/not retried, so an aborted generation cannot be billed twice; (2) providerFor(resolvedKey) exported, createProvider removed from the ai barrel (lint forces other features through it); (3) OpenAI filter keeps ft:*-search-preview, drops *-pro and gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct; (4) 403 is a forbidden kind -> 403 ai_key_forbidden (new additive code + en/pt-BR), OpenAI verify accepts a 403 from /models as authenticated; (5) log redaction covers key fragments, masked sk-* echoes and Z.ai id.secret keys; (6) Z.ai verifies via documented /tokenizer and lists the documented chat models offline; (7) verifyKey returns the models it fetched so save/test make one /models call; (8) status effective is null when the stored secret no longer opens. Verification: task typecheck exit 0; task lint exit 0; shared 203 pass/0 fail; api with BUDGET_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1 on :55432 1342 pass/0 fail/0 skip (90 files, 8458 expects).
Independent review of 378984a (attached review-ucyr.md): 11 findings; sent back for a second round. Not approved.
Second review round in f34eb55 (amends a partial commit; worktree clean). A: added kind timeout (chat deadline/caller abort); non-chat deadlines stay transient; AiChatRequest.signal wired through requestJson to fetch; caller-signal listeners released after each request; chat sets Bun fetch timeout:false because Bun docs give a 5-minute socket idle default below 640 s (probes: 320 s delayed response and 330 s silent connect did not hit it before our own signals, but it is disabled explicitly); chatTimeoutMs uses a 16k assumed cap when maxTokens is unset; adapter-level Anthropic test spies AbortSignal.timeout and requires 640000 for 16k and unset. B: OpenAI docs make missing endpoint scope 401 (Invalid Authentication), 403 is country/region only, so the 403-accepted path and ai_key_forbidden are removed; a key that cannot verify is not saved; any 403 is auth and the message is generic. C: Z.ai tokenizer cost is not documented, so verification is now POST /paas/v4/chat/completions on api.z.ai with max_tokens 1 on the chosen model or GLM-5.3-Flash (docs pricing: 0.15/M input, 0.50/M output); /ai/models verifies a candidate key before returning the suggestion list; a typed model outside the list is accepted on save; list comment fixed (text + FLASH/FLASHX/LEGAL, no vision claim). D: ResolvedAiKey is a class with a private secret and module-token constructor, public provider/model/source; providerFor rejects non-instances; createProvider is gone; makeResolvedAiKey is not on the barrel. E: redactSecrets exported; provider logs now only provider/kind/status; sk- pattern has a word boundary and dotted-key pattern requires a 32-hex id and 16+ secret, so desk-lamp/task-force/timestamps survive. F: OpenAI filter drops ft:babbage-002/davinci-002 and tool-less gpt-4o*-search-preview/chatgpt-4o-latest, keeps chat fine-tunes whose org/suffix has -pro-/-image-. G: Anthropic verifyKey returns the Models list so save/test use one list call. Docs: developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes, /models/gpt-4o-search-preview, /gpt-4o-mini-search-preview, /chatgpt-4o-latest, /babbage-002, /davinci-002; docs.z.ai/api-reference/llm/chat-completion, /guides/overview/pricing; bun.com/reference/globals/BunFetchRequestInit/timeout; platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models/list. Unconfirmed: no live provider calls (Z.ai max_tokens 1 acceptance, OpenAI statuses from docs); aborted-generation billing; Z.ai tokenizer cost. Verification: task typecheck exit 0; task lint exit 0; shared 203 pass/0 fail; api BUDGET_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1 on :55432 1352 pass/0 fail/0 skip (91 files, 8483 expects). Client: ai_key_forbidden removed (403 on AI routes is only own_ai_key_required); ai_key_rejected 400 now covers provider 401/403; Z.ai /ai/models and /ai/credentials/test now contact the provider and can 400 ai_key_rejected; Z.ai save accepts a model outside the suggestion list; own non-null with effective null still possible for an unreadable secret. No schema changes.
Third round in 28f3f4e (worktree clean, parent f34eb55). M1: OpenAiCompatibleProvider and AnthropicProvider hold the key in a private #apiKey; new providers/index.test.ts asserts JSON.stringify, util.inspect(showHidden) and Bun.inspect of both adapters contain no key. M2: redactSecrets adds the whole key value (any length) and runs the shape patterns before fragments; test with a 164-char sk-proj key asserts the exact redaction and no surviving 8-char run, plus a long shapeless key. 3: ResolvedAiKey freezes itself after construction; Reflect.set(provider/model) is refused and tested. 4: providerFor and adapter() take no options; tests build a stub table from the deep builtinProviders export via setProviders, and a test proves a caller-supplied option never reaches the table. 5: ai_credentials_test and the saved-key branch of /ai/models pass key.model; ZAI_KEY_CHECK_MODEL remains the only fallback and is used only when no model is chosen; route test covers save/list/test with glm-4.7. 6: chatTimeoutMs is capped at 15 min (900000 ms); tests 128k and 1M. 7: types.ts says most checks are side-effect-free but Z.ai is a small paid chat call; architecture.md describes the key as accidental-disclosure/public-factory protection (private field, frozen fields, no options, frozen table test seam) and explicitly not a sandbox for deliberate deep code; docs also note the 15-min cap and saved-model use. No shared/ changes (git diff f34eb55..28f3f4e -- shared/ empty). Verification: task typecheck exit 0; task lint exit 0; api full suite BUDGET_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1 on :55432: 1361 pass, 0 skip, 0 fail, 92 files, 8669 expects. Live provider behavior (Z.ai statuses/model acceptance) remains unconfirmed from docs.
Merged to local main (not pushed); owner approved in the Inbox thread on 2026-11-24. Three review rounds (review-ucyr.md, review-ucyr-2.md attached): timeout kind + abort signal + 15 min cap, opaque frozen resolved key with one providerFor, key hidden in adapters, redaction fixed for long keys, OpenAI 403 path removed per OpenAI docs, Z.ai verified by a 1-token chat on the saved model, provider text no longer logged or returned. api suite 1361 pass / 0 skip reported by the agent; orchestrator verified redaction and private key fields. Leftovers: budget-vnar.
